answer: Meta-grading closes the loop: each juror's verdict is itself sampled and re-judged against seeded honeypots and the consensus of other established panels. Approve a planted bad answer and the mismatch ripples upward, so the audit layer above slashes your bond and suspends the whole colluding ring. Capturing one grading seat is worthless; an attacker must corrupt the jurors AND the meta-jurors reviewing them, a fresh honest-looking quorum at every tier, while the sampling tide keeps reshuffling who audits whom. A single violet-flagged false approval unwinds a thousand fakes at once.
